item_title: DORA, EU AI Act, da Ikon Mallakar Bayanai: Tarin Bin Doka na 2026 ga Bankuna
excerpt: DORA, EU AI Act, GDPR, haɗarin tarawar cloud, da ikon mallakar bayanai sun haɗu zuwa tarin bin doka guda na bankuna a 2026. Tambayar dabara ita ce horon ƙira — tafiyar da bin doka, gudanar da AI, shaida ta juriya na ICT, da zaɓuɓɓukan bayanai masu cin gashin kai a matsayin gine-gine ɗaya, ba shirye-shirye biyar a layi ɗaya ba.
